messages:
Jamie (PM): Quick check — putting together a milestone timeline for the Dedicated Autoscale pilot. Need to map deps across runtime, infra, platform, and SRE. Can folks drop blockers and hard dates? Prefer to lock the critical path by EOD Friday. TL;DR: customer pilot in Sep requires GA readiness by 2026-10-15. Thoughts?

Alex K.: Runtime: main risk is kernel selection + quant inference perf. Need a final perf regression test pass (2 weeks) + one round of tuning. Blocker: missing perf profile from customer payloads. If we get profiles by 2026-08-03 we can target 2026-09-20 for runtime readiness.

Maria G.: Infra: we can provision dedicated pools but networking + KMS integration will take ~3 weeks after infra branch cut. Earliest realistic infra cut = 2026-09-01. That pushes overall to mid-Oct unless we parallelize work. Also EU region KMS requires a little config work and quota requests.

Sanjay R.: Platform: rollout API changes are small (feature flag + new route). We'll need the runtime stable + infra in staging. Estimate platform work ~2w. Can start once runtime tests pass, but can prep PRs earlier.

Kevin L. (CSE): Real customer note: they're flexible but asked for a canary in early Oct. They require data residency in eu-west1 — so infra region set matters for the pilot.

Jamie (PM): OK flags — customer payloads + eu region pinned. Proposal: 1) Customer sends payloads by 2026-08-03. 2) Runtime PERF pass 2026-08-10–2026-08-24. 3) Platform API work 2026-08-25–2026-09-08. 4) Infra branch cut 2026-09-01 (parallel) -> 3 weeks to KMS + region config. 5) Integration testing 2026-09-15–2026-10-05. GA target 2026-10-15. Where's the critical path? Looks like infra KMS + runtime perf.

Alex K.: Agree critical path = infra KMS + runtime perf. If infra can start earlier (we can backfill region config in staging), we could shorten by ~1 week.

Maria G.: We can try to start region config earlier if product is OK with a temporary quota bump. Need approval from Finance for quota cost.

Jamie (PM): Action items: @Kevin L. (CSE) get confirmation on payloads and eu requirement by Mon. @Finance please respond on quota bump by Wed. I'll spin up a living timeline doc and add tasks. Quick sync Thu 09:00 PT? :calendar:

OpsBot: deploy-bot: Next maintenance window 2026-09-02 02:00 UTC — may affect infra cutover.

Kevin L. (CSE): I'll confirm with customer today. If they can accept eu-west1 only, we can proceed.

Sanjay R.: I'll draft the API change PR template and a canary rollback plan.

Jamie (PM): Thanks everyone. I'll update the roadmap and ping you with the doc link. If anyone can't make Thu 09:00 PT — call it out now.
